description: As a manager, I want to export operational reports as PDF files so that I can share them with stakeholders who do not have system access.

acs.text: The Export button is available on the Reports page and triggers PDF generation.
The PDF includes: report title, date range, generated-by user, and all data rows visible in the current view.
A loading spinner is shown during generation. The button is disabled during this period.
On success, the file downloads automatically with the name format: report-{YYYY-MM-DD}.pdf
